meta.name: data-protection-law
meta.description: Swiss data protection — nDSG/FADP framework, GDPR adequacy, cantonal DP laws (IDG/KDSG/LIPAD), DSFA/DPIA, cross-border transfers. Trigger when: user asks about nDSG/GDPR compliance, DPAs, data transfers, DPIA, data subject rights, or references FDPIC/nDSG/FADP. Do NOT trigger for: fintech regulatory compliance (use compliance-frameworks), document analysis (swiss-document-analysis), or privilege routing (privacy-routing).
